Table 17. Alarms/Audible Tones Problems

| Symptom                                                                                                           | Recommended Action                                                                                                                                                    |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1. N5500 fails to power- up when Power On/Off switch is pressed.                                                  | 1. Take steps as noted in paragraph 5.5.1.                                                                                                                            |
| 2. N5500 powers-up, but some or one of the other switches respond.                                                | 1. Ensure Function switch PCB is plugged into Main PCB assembly. If connection is good, change Function switch PCB. 2. If problem persists, change Main PCB assembly. |
| 3. When knob is rotated, no highlight appears on display screen, and/or monitor does not respond to knob presses. | 1. Ensure encoder wire is plugged into Main PCB assembly. If connection is good, change encoder. 2. If problem persists, replace Main PCB assembly.                   |
